tasks.gr12-democracy-and-human-rights-t3: Topic: Democracy and Human Rights. Cover human rights violations, discrimination, redress, constitutional values and accountability in South Africa and globally. Ask learners to analyse a rights issue, identify appropriate redress, connect a case to constitutional values, or defend a rights-based response using evidence.
tasks.gr12-ideologies-media-and-citizenship-t3: Topic: Ideologies, Media and Citizenship. Cover ideology, bias, propaganda, social movements, media influence and responsible participation in democracy. Ask learners to compare sources, identify bias or propaganda, evaluate the effect of media messages on citizenship, or explain how responsible participation depends on critical literacy.
tasks.gr12-active-citizenship-and-leadership-t: Topic: Active Citizenship and Leadership. Cover civic participation, leadership, social justice, diversity, social cohesion and ethical action. Ask learners to evaluate community leadership scenarios, design a civic response to injustice, explain how diversity strengthens democracy, or reflect on the responsibilities of active citizens.
tasks.gr12-physical-education-task-3-t3: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 3. Cover fitness maintenance, teamwork, self-discipline, consistent participation and responsibility for health. Ask learners to reflect on participation records, explain teamwork or safe practice principles, or evaluate how self-discipline supports fitness and wellbeing.
tasks.gr12-human-factors-ill-health-t3: Topic: Human Factors in Ill-Health, Accidents and Disasters. Cover psychological, social, religious and cultural factors, different knowledge perspectives, the contributing factors named in the CAPS (eating habits, lack of exercise, smoking, substance abuse, unsafe sexual behaviour), and human factors in accidents, crises and disasters. Ask Grade 12 learners to classify a factor, link a habit to a risk, or explain how people make a disaster worse.
tasks.gr12-lifestyle-diseases-t3: Topic: Lifestyle Diseases and Interventions. Cover cancer, hypertension, diseases of the heart and circulatory system, tuberculosis and sexually transmitted infections including HIV and AIDS, poverty and gender imbalances, and the interventions: prevention and control, early detection, treatment, and care and support. Ask Grade 12 learners to match a disease to a contributing factor or an intervention, or explain why treatment must be completed.
tasks.gr12-physical-activity-plan-t3: Topic: A Long-Term Physical Activity Plan. Cover the long-term physical, mental, social and emotional effects of activity, an action plan with a goal, days and minutes, checking progress, and overcoming barriers. Ask Grade 12 learners to add up a weekly plan, compare it with a target, or choose a way round a barrier.
